candidate.title: OpenURI follows redirects, bypassing host allowlist when fetching embedded topic HTML
reports: open(url) at topicembed.rb:48 follows redirects, so the host check in topicretriever does not actually constrain what gets fetched — one open redirect on the embeddable host hands the attacker control of the imported html, feeding the xss/url-injection issues
